literal: In whichever way dwells the world, with the world in that same way to dwell is wisdom.
translation: To live in harmony with the world, adapting to the way the world lives, is true wisdom.
modern: உலகம் எத்தகைய வழியில் வாழ்கிறதோ, அந்த உலகத்தோடு பொருந்தி அதே வழியில் வாழ்வதே அறிவாகும்.
explanation: This couplet defines wisdom not as isolated intellectual knowledge, but as the practical ability to adapt and live in harmony with society. The word 'உலகம்' (world) here refers to the wise and noble people of the world. 'எவ்வது உறைவது' means 'in whichever way they live', and 'அவ்வது உறைவது' means 'living in that very same manner'. True wisdom ('அறிவு') lies in conforming to the righteous customs and conduct of the community rather than standing apart in stubborn isolation.
